summary: Collections removed from the Ansible 11 package: frr.frr, inspur.sm, ngine_io.exoscale, openvswitch.openvswitch and t_systems_mms.icinga_director. They can still be installed with ansible-galaxy.
questions: Which collections were dropped in Ansible 11?
How do I get openvswitch.openvswitch back after upgrading?

answer_card.title: Collections removed in Ansible 11
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed: `frr.frr` (2.0.2), `inspur.sm` (2.3.0), `ngine_io.exoscale` (1.1.0), `openvswitch.openvswitch` (2.1.1), `t_systems_mms.icinga_director` (2.0.1).

Install any of them manually if needed:

```shell
ansible-galaxy collection install openvswitch.openvswitch
```
